```artifact
Feature: Hospital Staff Information Acquisition and Feedback

  Scenario: Hospital Staff Identifies Information from Patients, Chemists, and Labs
    Given Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they access the information module
    Then they can identify information acquired from Patients, Chemists, and Labs

  Scenario: Hospital Staff States the Requirements of the Software
    Given Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they access the requirements module
    Then they can state the requirements of the software

  Scenario: Hospital Staff Provides Feedback to Modify Existing Requirements
    Given Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they access the feedback module
    Then they can provide feedback to modify existing requirements

  Scenario: Document Serves as Reference for Project Management and Development Team
    Given Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they access the reference document
    Then the document serves as a reference for Project Management and Development team (Mishal and Samyak)

  Scenario Outline: Project Management and Development Team Analyzes, Designs, and Implements the System
    Given Project Management and Development team has access to the system
    When they perform <action>
    Then the system is <result>
    Examples:
      | action         | result         |
      | Analyze        | analyzed       |
      | Design         | designed       |
      | Implement      | implemented    |
```
